title: Achievements
description: Experience points, levels and achievements earned from what you record. The rules are fixed and written out below.

level.title: Level {{level}}
level.explain: Each level needs 100 XP more than the one before: level 2 starts at 100, level 3 at 300, level 4 at 600 XP.

habit_first.name: First step
habit_first.description: Complete a habit for the first time.

habit_100.name: A hundred days
habit_100.description: Complete your habits 100 times in total.

habit_500.name: Five hundred days
habit_500.description: Complete your habits 500 times in total.

streak_7.name: One-week streak
streak_7.description: Keep a habit going for 7 days in a row.

streak_30.name: One-month streak
streak_30.description: Keep a habit going for 30 days in a row.

streak_100.name: Hundred-day streak
streak_100.description: Keep a habit going for 100 days in a row.

rules.title: How is XP earned?
rules.description: Points are worked out on the server from your records: once per record, and taken back if the record is undone.
rules.habit_completed: Completing a habit for the day
rules.focus_block: Every 5 minutes of a completed focus session (at most {{cap}} XP per session)
rules.journal_written: Writing in the journal (once a day)

recent.title: Recently earned
recent.empty: No XP earned yet. Start by completing a habit or finishing a task.
